# IMPERIA COLD WAR — Chile 1970 national programme. Generated by tools/chile_1970/compile.py.
on_actions = {
	on_startup = {
		effect = {
			if = {
				limit = { country_exists = CHL }
				CHL = { COLDWAR_CHL_initialize = yes COLDWAR_CHL_refresh_all = yes }
			}
		}
	}
	# COLDWAR | hand patch 07.11.2026 (performance): runs only for the tag it is meant for (on_daily_TAG instead of a tag check in every country).
	on_daily_CHL = {
		effect = {
			if = {
				limit = { COLDWAR_CHL_is_scenario = yes }
				COLDWAR_CHL_daily = yes
			}
		}
	}
	on_daily = {
		effect = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					IMP_is_1970_scenario = yes
					NOT = { check_variable = { global.COLDWAR_CHL_world_diplomacy_day = global.num_days } } # COLDWAR | hand patch 07.11.2026 (performance): a day stamp instead of a 1-day flag, the flag did not stop the other ~200 countries (benchmark)
				}
				set_variable = { global.COLDWAR_CHL_world_diplomacy_day = global.num_days }
				COLDWAR_CHL_diplomacy_world_daily = yes
			}
		}
	}
	on_government_change = {
		effect = {
			if = {
				limit = { COLDWAR_CHL_is_scenario = yes }
				COLDWAR_CHL_refresh_all = yes
			}
		}
	}
	on_ruling_party_change = {
		effect = {
			if = {
				limit = { COLDWAR_CHL_is_scenario = yes }
				COLDWAR_CHL_refresh_all = yes
			}
		}
	}
	on_war_relation_added = {
		effect = {
			if = {
				limit = { country_exists = CHL }
				CHL = {
					if = {
						limit = { COLDWAR_CHL_is_scenario = yes }
						COLDWAR_CHL_refresh_all = yes
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
	on_peaceconference_ended = {
		effect = {
			if = {
				limit = { country_exists = CHL }
				CHL = {
					if = {
						limit = { COLDWAR_CHL_is_scenario = yes }
						COLDWAR_CHL_refresh_all = yes
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
}
